budget.rationale: The seven categories reconcile to $10,800–$15,000, but the high case reaches the preferred maximum and the open-jaw airfare, peak-June lodging, and two island car rentals remain medium-confidence 2027 proxies. The rubric therefore caps Budget at 2/5 until a high-confidence family quote confirms the band.

weather.rationale: June on the Ionian is reliably dry (~1–3 rain days) and warm (highs ~78–84°F). It falls short of 5 only because the west-facing Lefkada beaches (Porto Katsiki, Kathisma, Kavalikefta) catch a building afternoon NW breeze that chops up the surface — a real, plan-around-it caveat rather than a washout.

swim.rationale: Warm, calm, genuinely turquoise Ionian water at ~72–74°F in June, with sheltered family-easy swimming at Assos harbor, Antisamos, Lassi/Makris Gialos, and Agios Nikitas/Milos. It is a 4 not a 5 because the marquee Myrtos shelves steeply with waves (a wade-not-swim beach for the 8-year-old) and the west-coast beaches are morning-only before the afternoon chop.

variety.rationale: A focused island-and-sea trip: turquoise beaches, the Melissani/Drogarati caves, the pastel villages of Assos and Fiskardo, a Zakynthos boat day, and light gorge/waterfall and windmill walks. Rich within its lane, but it lacks the mountains, big cities, or major cultural sites that push a route to 5.

ease.rationale: The board's easiest warm-water plan: arrival at well-connected EFL is single-ticketable via Athens, then one direct ~1h ferry, short island drives on the gentle Ionian, and a road causeway (no ferry) linking Lefkada to the PVK departure. It is held off 5 by the open-jaw, the thin charter-served PVK departure leg, and renting a separate car on each island.

food.rationale: Easy for picky eaters: reliable pizza/pasta/grilled-chicken tavernas and pizzerias in Sami, Argostoli, Nydri, and Lefkada Town (Pomodoro, Made in Love, Tereza, Ampelaki). Upscale Fiskardo and Assos skew to seafood, so plain-food meals are planned in the bigger towns and those two become parents'-choice splurge nights.

risk.rationale: The departure-side PVK leg is a separate low-cost/charter ticket (self-transfer, low frequency) whose disruption threatens the Jun 24–26 Pittsburgh blackout; the single inter-island ferry is schedule-dependent; Navagio is closed to landing; and Myrtos swimming is hazardous for young children. These are mitigated by the single-ticket EFL arrival, a held Jun 23 buffer day, and abundant calm swim alternatives.

nights.rationale: Twelve hotel nights (Kefalonia 7 + Lefkada 5) derive 5/5 under the canonical nights rubric.

novelty.rationale: Greece is already represented on the board by the Crete-focused greece-via-lisbon plan, so this is a different region rather than a new country. The Ionian (Lefkada, Kefalonia, Zakynthos) does not overlap the visited-place list, deriving 4/5 rather than 5.

pto.rationale: Nine PTO days derive 2/5 under the slider rubric and carry zero default weight; Juneteenth observed (Fri Jun 18) lands mid-trip as a no-PTO active day.
